content.summary: Netflix  struck a $72 billion deal to buy Warner Bros., beating out Paramount and  Comcast  —and shocking Hollywood.  The acquisition would combine the largest global streaming service with the company behind HBO Max, the Superman and Harry Potter movies and hit TV shows such as “Friends.”  Warner plans to split its cable networks off into a separate company before the deal closes.
